description: Windows x86_64 PE parity profile for the strict, MFC-free Hammer core (RFC 0002 compatibility target). The same conformance suites as linux-headless-core are cross-compiled to native Windows PE with the MinGW-w64 g++ toolchain (statically linked) and executed under Wine and GE-Proton, proving the extracted modules behave identically on Windows and Linux. This profile is run by tools/quality/parity_wine.py, not the native runner. It does NOT cover the legacy MFC shell, which requires Visual Studio's MFC headers/libs that are not present in this environment.
